name: Chao Chi
bio: Chao Chi (趙佶; Zhao Ji; 1082–1135) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty. He reigned as Emperor Hui-tsung, was a celebrated painter and calligrapher, and died in captivity among the Jurchen after the fall of the capital in 1127.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 燕山亭 (Yan shan ting)
poems.author: Chao Chi
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
裁翦冰绡，打叠数重，冷淡燕脂匀注。
新样靓妆，艳溢香融，羞杀蕊珠宫女。
易得凋零，更多少、无情风雨。
愁苦。
闲院落凄凉，几番春暮。
凭寄离恨重重，这双燕，何曾会人言语。
天遥地远，万水千山，知他故宫何处。
怎不思量，除梦里、有时会去。
无据。
和梦也、有时不做。
